## Summary

Direct follow-up to [[2026-10-27-margincall4-l-s-breakout-portfolio-addition]]: the author extended the same long/short breakout strategy from the ~4-year window to 10 years (2017–2026, after costs), kicked out SPY ("just a lower return version of QQQ") and swapped in less-correlated TSLA. Same algo, no setting changes, running on 3 markets.

## Why it matters

- The diversifier claim survives the longer window and strengthens: combined Sharpe 2.34 vs every sleeve ≤1.61, t-score 8.32 on 2,735 trades. Trades/yr (~279) matches the prior 2022–2026 run (289) — consistent test density, not a re-tuned fluke.
- The TSLA swap is correlation logic made concrete: SPY was the drag sleeve in yesterday's table (PF 1.26, Sharpe 0.90, redundant with QQQ); TSLA enters at Sharpe 1.61 / PF 1.55 with only -10.2% max DD — the upgrade shows up directly in the combined line (Sharpe 1.89 → 2.34).
- **Skepticism gates:** 55.3%/yr uses fixed-starting-capital return math — same inflation risk flagged on the prior capture; 10 years at that rate is an extraordinary claim resting on chart-OCR numbers. Win rates cluster suspiciously tight (51.2–52.7%). The 2017 start conveniently spans a monster BTC and TSLA decade. Verify cells against full-res before quoting.
